snippet.title: Stranded with You - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Store: https://saikeystudios.com/product/160112/stranded-with-you/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4260270/Stranded_with_You/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post

In this survival game, you are stranded on an tropical island with your lovely friend Mitsuki. Explore your surroundings together, build a small shelter, and hunt for supplies. Have fun keeping up with all the heat!
